candidates.review_note: A prime is a sum of two positive squares iff it is2 or congruent1 mod4. Sieve base primes to sqrt(r), then sieve only interval candidates congruent1 mod4; their multiples of each odd prime form stride p in compressed indices. Start at p^2 to retain prime itself. O((r-l)/4) bytes instead of a full 3e8-element integer sieve.

A chosen set is payable iff total demand<=P+2Q and number of odd demands<=P. Every odd amount needs one one-rupee coin; remaining even amounts can use twos or pairs of ones. For each cardinality, cheapest set under the odd-count cap is produced by increasing demands while skipping excess odds. Stop when next admissible demand exceeds total money.

Connectivity after removing at most T obstacles is equivalent to a path with obstacle cost<=T, including both endpoints. Run 0-1 BFS from each possible start, charging each entered blocked cell, then maximize Euclidean squared endpoint distance among reachable cells. This is not shortest-path geometric distance. Output square root once to six decimals.

All top floor(n/2) in each semifinal qualify at maximal k, and global top n qualify at k0. Any other participant has local rank>n/2>=k and global rank>n; removing the forced top k cannot improve its residual rank enough. Thus union of these two extreme configurations is exactly all possible finalists.

Preserve figure input order; test strict rectangle interior or circle squared distance below radius squared. Decimal parsing avoids binary float artifacts for boundary points. Report every containing figure and a single none line only if no figure matches; sentinel is not a query.

Count the complement: digit strings where consecutive lucky digits are separated by more than k positions. Cooldown DP precomputes suffix completions, with 8 nonlucky and2 lucky digits. Digit-bound traversal counts safe numbers<=N, including harmless leading zeros, then subtracts from N+1 modulo MOD. Inclusive interval correction tests whether l itself violates cooldown. O(maxdigits*k+total query digits).

Compress initial equal runs. Interval DP tracks whether its first run has at least one equal character carried from the left. Either erase a run of size>=2 then solve remainder, or clear the middle and merge first run into a later equal run. One carried character is sufficient because removal threshold is2; memoization explores all legal choices, including cases where early erasure would lose solvability.
